style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

preserve: Every logical frame/root/sourceScale and per-clip/direction override
Original footprint, height/proportions, sockets, ports, rigs and projection
Every registered clip, facing, frame count and fps/loop behavior
Lighting without preferred horizontal direction for rotatable world objects; no directional ground cast shadow
Actual independent geometry views and native animation; no raster card or per-view image fitting/recolor
judgeMeasuredRequirements: Retain the actual golden ribbed hanging lantern construction: plinth, brown upright post, forward overhang, hook, octagonal paper body, five ribs and two wood caps. Preserve the original modeled identity, proportions and geometry envelope; target shape drift is not authority.

Retain logical frame 192x384, logical root 96,288, sourceScale 2, rendered frame 384x768, one-cell footprint, registered height 1.34 and every existing camera/projection/pixel-aspect/per-clip override.

Retain the declared ground root and native transform/attachment relationships, all four N/E/S/W facings, and all 12 unique idle frames at 12 fps with looping timing and original small cage sway. Exclude the duplicate closure key from runtime frames.
Render actual editable 3D geometry, with one capture contract for every direction/frame. No raster card, target projection, per-view fit or per-view recoloring.
Illumination has no preferred horizontal direction; no directional ground cast shadow. Preserve true transparent background, with no bloom/halo painted outside the modeled silhouette.
The source palette family stays golden yellow paper/ribs with warm brown wooden supports. No added props, graphics, outlines or redesign.

aestheticGoals.observableSuccess: The cage remains compact and ribbed with its original five-band rhythm, octagonal character, caps and support silhouette. Edges read softly rounded through light and modest bevel treatment; faces have continuous readable volume without becoming inflated, melted or cylindrical.
failureSignals: Softened silhouette that grows beyond the source envelope
Abrupt flat-face steps dominating the paper surface

aestheticGoals.observableSuccess: Paper and ribs read as warm gold/honey yellow, with small warm highlight areas and amber shadow transitions. Brown wood stays brown and remains distinguishable from the gold body. Preserve useful separation among paper, rib bands, caps and post at logical game size.
failureSignals: Neon lemon or orange/red palette drift

aestheticGoals.observableSuccess: Broad gentle highlights and soft face transitions give warm cartoon volume. The lantern feels internally luminous while all structural bands remain legible. Identically oriented exposed faces receive a balanced treatment as the object rotates, and the wood has enough fill to avoid dead black areas.

Paper, gold ribs and wood have distinct but restrained surface response. Wood face/bevel variation gives the base and mount depth without noisy grain or shiny plastic; ribs have soft edges but remain deliberate structural forms. Detail remains subordinate to the readable lantern shape.
failureSignals: Uneven bright rims competing with the body

aestheticGoals.observableSuccess: All four facings and the entire idle loop remain clean and immediately readable at 192x384 logical scale. The hanging cage sways as an assembly while the support stays planted; caps/ribs stay joined, and the loop closes without a visible jump. Transparent edges are clean on light, gray and dark backgrounds.
failureSignals: Black patches, seams or broken corners

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
